testFlight.betaAppDescription: ShotLab connects basketball coaches and players around daily training, shot logging, program work, events, strength sessions, leaderboards, and long-term development.
testFlight.whatToTest: Verify Coach and Player sign-in, core navigation, training and shot logging, event commitments, leaderboards, progress, safe-area behavior, keyboard behavior, relaunch persistence, offline recovery, and account deletion. Report any visual seam, blocked action, stale data, duplicate submission, or session-recovery issue.

completionRule: Do not mark this handoff complete until the signed build has run on a physical iPhone and the processed internal TestFlight build has been installed and smoke-tested.
